replicated_originals.reference: Rydell, McConnell, Mackie & Strain (2006) Of two minds: Forming and changing valence-inconsistent implicit and explicit attitudes

A.reason: Rydell & McConnell (2006, JPSP) is cited as the systems-of-reasoning theory and as one of two similar studies by the original authors. It is not the target of the replication.

B.reason: The title is 'A registered replication of Rydell et al. (2006)'. Experiments 1 and 2 closely replicate this Psychological Science study (subliminal primes vs. behavioural information on IAT and explicit attitudes) using the original materials.

notes: Two experiments, both close replications of the same original: Exp 1 in Germany with translated materials, Exp 2 with US undergraduates and a shorter prime duration. The explicit-attitude effect replicated; the prime effect on implicit attitudes did not.
